description: Machine form of DIAGNOSTIC_ARCHITECTURE_v0.1.md. 'feeds' are Mission Packet JSON paths ([] = each array item). Checked by tools/kta_check.py --registry.

questions.intent: What's prompting you to look at how AI is changing your work, right now?
questions.change_test: Acute signals -> DQ-02/out_of_scope; tool rollout -> protect/leverage; move into X -> transition; 'is it true?' -> clarify + understanding_gap.

questions.intent: Is this mainly about something happening right now, or planning ahead?
questions.change_test: Acute -> out_of_scope (signpost, no packet); mixed -> in_scope_operator_attention; planning -> in_scope.

questions.intent: Role, rough seniority, kind of organisation/sector, employment type (no employer name).
questions.change_test: Employment type decides whose AI policy governs; seniority gates visibility/delegation experiments. Never drives mission alone.

questions.intent: In 1-3 years, if this went well, what's observably different about your work, and by when?
questions.change_test: Less grind -> leverage; moved into X -> transition; not worried -> clarify (explain-first).

questions.intent: 0-10: how confident are you today that you're on track for that?
questions.change_test: <=3 -> explanation step first + smaller experiment; >=8 -> prefer a disconfirming experiment.

questions.intent: Last (typical) week: the 4-8 main things you produced, decided or handled, in your own words.
questions.change_test: Defines the entire focus-area candidate space.

questions.intent: Rough time split across those tasks (big/medium/small or %).
questions.change_test: Strongest focus-selection input (MPR-03); 'no idea' -> time_audit experiment candidate.

questions.intent: (a) Could a capable newcomer follow written instructions to your standard? (b) If it went wrong, who'd notice, what happens? (c) Would you miss it or be glad to lose it?
questions.change_test: Writable + big -> leverage candidate (MPR-04); depends on reading people -> anchor-value (MPR-05); would miss -> identity protection (MPR-08).

questions.intent: Have you used AI tools for any of these tasks? What happened?
questions.change_test: Never -> guided shadow test if policy allows; tried/disappointed -> separate tool limit (world_fact) from skill (personal); regular -> value/visibility/transition experiments.

questions.intent: Employer/client rules on AI with work material; approved tools; which main tasks involve confidential information.
questions.change_test: Safety gate INV-08: unknown -> public/synthetic only + policy_check step; approved tools -> real-material shadow test with those tools; prohibited -> no AI on work material.

questions.ask: if DQ-01 gave no specific concern
questions.intent: What concerns you most about AI and your work, as specifically as you can?
questions.change_test: Concern on small-share task -> omission + explanation (MPR-10); whole-occupation concern -> world_fact research + explanation, not the experiment driver.

questions.intent: Realistic time per week over the next month.
questions.change_test: Caps experiment effort and plan (INV-07); <30 min/week -> micro-experiments only.

questions.intent: Anything off-limits or hard (at work, money, parts you don't want to change)?
